Adani Group firms settle Sebi proceedings for Rs 1.5 crore

Five Adani Group companies have settled Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) proceedings by paying Rs 1.5 crore. The settlement resolves adjudication proceedings concerning alleged lapses in disclosure of related-party transactions and auditor compliance issues. The agreement was reached without any admission of guilt.
